provider_checks.name: DBLP public SPARQL service
provider_checks.status: A 64-cell title-only census completed on 2026-08-07. The exact query and 55 unique returned publications are preserved; 50 were absent from both prior comparison sets. DBLP is replacement evidence, not a publisher-native or Scopus-equivalent source.

interpretation: A missing exact DOI in the deterministic sample demonstrates a coverage gap but does not estimate recall for all software-engineering literature. A follow-up known-set audit found all 26 TSE candidates from the probe in SciX by exact DOI; that result does not estimate topic-search recall within TSE or replace IEEE Xplore. The DBLP census exposed 50 title-matched publications absent from both the manuscript reference set and the OpenAlex probe, especially in conference streams, but lacks abstract and keyword search and is not equivalent to Scopus. Exact-DOI enrichment supported preliminary model triage. Source-hashed, page-level verification now covers all 18 open-routed candidates plus 13 of the 16 records initially routed as closed; the other three have explicit access exceptions. All author decisions remain pending and no recommendation is an admission. The archival edition remains conditional on author screening of that queue and completing the prepared ACM and IEEE searches plus either Scopus execution or an explicitly accepted documented exclusion.
